memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the Lord at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, 'You have no share in the Lord.' And we said, 'If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the Lord's altar, which our ancestors built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.'" — Josh 22:27-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The altar was never meant for sacrifice at all. It was a witness — a silent, standing testimony that these tribes worshipped the same Lord at the same sanctuary as their brothers across the river. It was a copy of God's altar, built not to divide but to declare, "We belong to the Lord too."

How different the reality was from the fear. What looked like rebellion was actually a monument to unity. What appeared to be division was a heartfelt effort to preserve belonging for generations to come.

This reminds us how valuable it is to have visible witnesses to our faith. Throughout Scripture, God's people set up memorials — stones, altars, feasts — so that later generations would ask, "What does this mean?" and be told the story of God's faithfulness (Josh 4:6-7).

For us today, the great witness is not a pile of stones but the Lord's table, where we remember Christ's body and blood until He comes (1 Cor 11:26). Every time we take the bread and cup, we declare together, "We belong to the Lord; we share in His salvation." Let your life be a clear witness — in word, in worship, in the ordinances of the church — that leaves no doubt about whose you are and whom you serve.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is your faith visible enough to prompt others to ask about it?
2. How does the Lord's Supper testify that you belong to Christ?
3. What "witness" are you leaving that points others to God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let my life be a clear witness that I belong to You. Thank You for the table where I remember Christ and declare my share in His salvation. Amen.
